DataSource.query:
begin
SELECT
FORMAT(dat.[DATE], 'yyyy') as NUM_YEAR,
comp.COD_COMPANY as ORIGIN_COMPANY,
alloc.ID_ALLOCATION,
cust.COD_CUSTOMER,
'M-'+COD_PRODUCT_MODEL as PRODUCT_MODEL,
LAB_MODEL_FR as PRODUCT_MODEL_FR,
sum(case when fsl.QTY_MACHINE_INVOICED is null then 0 else fsl.QTY_MACHINE_INVOICED end) as QUANTITY,
sum(case when fsl.AMT_NET_TURNOVER_PIVOT_CUR is null then 0 else fsl.AMT_NET_TURNOVER_PIVOT_CUR end) as NET_SALES_EUROS
FROM
ACCOUNTING.FACT_SAVING_LEDGER fsl
inner join COMMON.DIM_COMPANY comp on fsl.SEQ_SOURCE_COMPANY = comp.SEQ_COMPANY
inner join COMMON.DIM_ALLOCATION alloc on fsl.SEQ_ALLOCATION = alloc.SEQ_ALLOCATION
inner join COMMON.DIM_CUSTOMER_COGNOS cust on fsl.SEQ_INVOICE_CUSTOMER_COGNOS = cust.SEQ_CUSTOMER_COGNOS
inner join COMMON.DIM_PRODUCT_MODEL mod on fsl.SEQ_PRODUCT_MODEL = mod.SEQ_PRODUCT_MODEL
inner join COMMON.DIM_DATE_VIEW dat on fsl.SEQ_ENTRY_DAY = dat.SEQ_DAY
where 
        year(dat.[DATE]) >= year(DATEADD(YEAR, -2, GETDATE()))
    and (case when fsl.AMT_NET_TURNOVER_PIVOT_CUR is null then 0 else fsl.AMT_NET_TURNOVER_PIVOT_CUR end <> 0 or case when fsl.QTY_MACHINE_INVOICED is null then 0 else fsl.QTY_MACHINE_INVOICED end <> 0)
GROUP BY 
    FORMAT(dat.[DATE], 'yyyy'),
    comp.COD_COMPANY,
    alloc.ID_ALLOCATION,
    cust.COD_CUSTOMER,
    'M-'+COD_PRODUCT_MODEL,
	LAB_MODEL_FR 
end
